entities.summary: Lieutenant General Andrei Alyakseyevich Ravkov is a Belarusian General and military leader who served as Minister of Defence from 2014 to 2020 and as the State Secretary of the Security Council of Belarus in 2020. He is currently the Ambassador to Azerbaijan.
